name: Gmail API messages.send
description: Send-email operation family of the Gmail API. Classified irreversible by this project (an inference, not a vendor statement): once delivered, the message is outside the sender's control.

provenance.notes: Supports gmail.send scope ('Send email on your behalf', Sensitive) and OAuth scopes model; narrowest-scope advice.
messages.send costs 100 quota units; 6,000 units per user per minute; 1,200,000 per project per minute; truncated exponential backoff advised. Version v1 from the REST reference path.
